Filmmaker Jenner Furst joins Tucker Carlson to talk about secret biotech work in China and a film that could jail Dr. Fauci. The title frames the film as a legal threat. Furst speaks as the maker of that film.

Furst lays out what his film claims about labs, virus work, and the men who funded it. He argues the paper trail leads back to Fauci and his allies. Carlson draws out the parts of the film most likely to stir a court fight. Listeners get the maker's case in full, in his own words. The library keeps the talk as a record of the claim and its aims.
